claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves LG 18650HB6 1500mAh 30A as a 1500mAh preset with a 30A runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 30A continuous discharge.

The LG HB6 specification and specialist cell listings identify an unprotected flat-top 18650 cell of approximately 18.3 mm x 65.0 mm; the manufacturer specification does not define a retail wrapper color.
LG 18650HB6 is documented as a lithium-ion cell, but the surviving manufacturer SDS does not disclose its exact cathode formulation.
The exact catalog entry LG 18650HB6 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-06-20 or earlier.

reviews.summary: Eligible Battery Mooch exact-model test conclusion retained with its original evidence date.
reservations: The conclusion applies to the tested sample and observable revision, not every later batch.

authenticity.summary: LG's HB6 cell identity and specifications are well supported, but authenticity of an individual bare or wrapped sample still requires provenance and physical inspection.
checks: Buy from a traceable source and compare the cell markings/terminal construction with the LG specification and a known-good sample.
Inspect the wrapper, top insulator, and weld/terminal geometry for damage or relabeling.
Do not assume a cell marked HB6 is genuine solely from the printed model name.
